programme.title: Oy to the World!
programme.desc: Old high school rivals must put aside their differences as they work together on a fundraising event for a damaged temple. In doing so, they soon discover that teamwork can move mountains and open hearts, including their own.

programme.title: Merry & Bright
programme.desc: Merry and Bright Candy Cane Company owner Cate meets a man during the busy Christmas season and assumes he is the suitor her mother is trying to set her up with.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
programme.desc: Single dad Taylor is inspired more than ever to give his two children the best Christmas in their new town. He leads the city's holiday event department, as new colleague Sophie supervises him.

programme.title: A Make or Break Holiday
programme.desc: A couple decide they need a break from each other as stress and unspoken irritations reach a boiling point. However, as they work together to create a memorable Christmas for their families, they soon rediscover what they love about each other.

programme.title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: A snowbound stranger (Warren Christie) brightens the holidays for a retired police officer (Henry Winkler) and his niece (Brooke Burns).

programme.title: Forgotten Holiday
programme.desc: After an accident leading to sudden memory loss, Kathryn must re-date her boyfriend of one year, Rob, in an effort to get his memories back and remind him of his love of Christmas.

programme.title: The Nights Before Christmas
programme.desc: Marty gets caught in a time loop on Christmas Eve -- and he loves it. Then he meets down-on-her-luck Chloe, and for the first time since the loop started, he wants to see Christmas day.

programme.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
programme.desc: After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas bar following his passing, she competes against its neighboring competitor, and its manager Zach, to help save it from its drowning debt.

programme.title: Tidings for the Season
programme.desc: News anchor Adam is challenged by superfan Robbie to report good news at Christmas. Adam reluctantly takes him under his wing and finds a connection with Robbie's mom.

programme.title: Long Lost Christmas
programme.desc: Hayley is an interior designer who plans to surprise her recently widowed mother with the perfect holiday present -- the extended family she knows her mom yearns for.

programme.title: Christmas Under the Lights
programme.desc: Emily reluctantly returns home to her family's rescue ranch to organize the Christmas Carnival and works with a handsome artist to honor her mother.

programme.title: Flipping for Christmas
programme.desc: It's almost Christmas when busy realtor Abigail agrees to help her sister with the simple flip of a recently inherited home. Unfortunately, co-beneficiary Bo has other plans in mind.

programme.title: Christmas in Montana
programme.desc: Before the holidays, Sara, an efficiency expert, goes to Montana and attempts to help a man save his ranch.

programme.title: The Snow Must Go On
programme.desc: A former Broadway star agrees to direct his niece's high school Christmas musical in the hopes of impressing an influential Broadway producer.

programme.title: The Christmas Cottage
programme.desc: As maid of honor for her best friend Ava, cynical interior designer Lacey is tasked with decorating a honeymoon cottage for the newlyweds. Although it's a simple enough task, she didn't plan on being snowed in with the bride-to-be's sexy brother.

programme.title: A Newport Christmas
programme.desc: The charitable Ella heads out on a boat in 1905 and ends up in 2025. Nick has to figure out how to get her back in time and decide if their newfound love can stand the test of it.

programme.title: We Met in December
programme.desc: After a magical night sharing hopes, dreams and a perfect kiss, strangers Annie and Dave lose each other with no way to connect. They embark on a quest to find each other by Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas With Holly
programme.desc: The owner (Eloise Mumford) of a toy store falls in love with a man (Sean Faris) who cares for his orphaned niece.

programme.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
programme.desc: After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas bar following his passing, she competes against its neighboring competitor, and its manager Zach, to help save it from its drowning debt.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas
programme.desc: The queen of Cordinia schemes to break up her royal son's romance with a seamstress from Philadelphia.

programme.title: Crown for Christmas
programme.desc: After getting fired from her job as a maid at a ritzy New York City hotel, a woman accepts a temporary job as governess to a young girl who is part of a powerful European family.

programme.title: A Not So Royal Christmas
programme.desc: A tabloid journalist tries to land an interview with a reclusive count during the holidays. In response, the royal family asks a groundskeeper to pose as the count since the real one fled years ago.

programme.title: Once Upon a Holiday
programme.desc: When a royal princess runs away from her official obligations and duties, she starts to fall in love with a good Samaritan who is unaware of her real identity.

programme.title: A Cozy Christmas Inn
programme.desc: A real estate executive travels to Alaska during the holidays to acquire a bed-and-breakfast, only to discover it's owned by her ex. She's soon falling in love with the town and quite possibly him all over again.

programme.title: Holiday Mismatch
programme.desc: New retiree Barb joins a Holiday Committee but clashes with long-standing member Kath. When they realize their kids have started dating, they conspire to break up the happy couple.

programme.title: Christmas Next Door
programme.desc: Eric Randall, an author of bachelor lifestyle books, is left in charge of his young niece and nephew for the holidays. Unsure of himself, Eric turns to his neighbor April, a lover of all things Christmas, for help.

programme.title: Christmas Tree Lane
programme.desc: When music store owner Meg spearheads community efforts to save her street from demolition, she is shocked to find out that the man she's falling for is working for the company that she is fighting.

programme.title: A Bramble House Christmas
programme.desc: While settling his father's estate, a man becomes suspicious as to why the man left his nurse a large sum of money after knowing her for less than two months before he died.

programme.title: Christmas Under Wraps
programme.desc: After unexpectedly moving to Alaska, an ambitious doctor starts a new romance and learns that her small town is hiding a holiday secret.

programme.title: Five More Minutes
programme.desc: Inspired by Scotty McCreery's song "Five More Minutes," a woman's Christmas wish is answered in unexpected ways when her late grandfather's journal turns up and reveals an untold romance.

programme.title: Five Star Christmas

programme.title: NFL Football
programme.desc: The Dallas Cowboys host the San Francisco 49ers in NFL regular-season play at AT&T Stadium. San Francisco is tied with Buffalo for the league's best record at 7-1, while Dallas would love to even its record at 5-5 with an upset victory.
